meta_description: 17K likes, 347 comments - thefoodranger on August 29, 2026: "Trying the viral Greek salad reimagined at @ateno.athens , an amazing place to try modern Greek cuisine. This place serves up incredibly delicious modern Greek food and I fell in love with Michelin chef @nikos_karathanos Nikos Karathanos recipes, in particular this super unique stuffed tomato Greek salad! Huge thanks to Jimmy @jim__238 our server as well for the amazing service and hospitality! I am definitely gonna revisit on my next visit to Athens because their food was so so delicious and the service was incredible and the vibe was perfect! Don’t miss this place on your next visit to Athens!".
